toegepas.voor: al hoe meer onder vreemde ryke gekom
toegepas.na: al hoe meer onder die mag van vreemde ryke gekom
toegepas.rede_vinder: A country comes 'onder die mag van' an empire; 'onder vreemde ryke gekom' is unidiomatic, and the added words are all one syllable, so the long-word ratio is not raised.
toegepas.fout: 'onder vreemde ryke gekom' is a loose construction; Afrikaans says a country comes under the power (mag/heerskappy) of another.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal is the natural fixed expression, keeps the protected 'ryke' intact, adds no fact and only adds short words.

toegepas.voor: Die leerder moet sien van waar die Perse, die Grieke en die Romeine gekom het wat Egipte oorgeneem het.
toegepas.na: Die leerder moet sien waar die Perse, die Grieke en die Romeine, wat Egipte oorgeneem het, vandaan gekom het.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'van waar' is an anglicism for 'waar ... vandaan', and the relative clause stood separated from the nouns it describes.
toegepas.fout: 'van waar ... gekom het' copies English 'from where', and the relative clause 'wat Egipte oorgeneem het' trails at the end, cut off from the nouns it describes.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'waar ... vandaan gekom het' is the natural Afrikaans form and the clause now sits beside its nouns; 'oorgeneem' was already in the original and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: Sterker ryke en die stryd om Rome het so die einde
toegepas.na: So het sterker ryke en die stryd om Rome die einde
toegepas.rede_vinder: The summarising 'so' reads naturally at the head of the sentence; wedged after 'het' it is wooden.
toegepas.fout: The summarising 'so', placed after 'het' and behind a long compound subject, reads stiffly and gets lost.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'So het sterker ryke ... die einde gebring' is how a fluent writer opens a summing-up sentence, and the people, actions and meaning stay the same.

laat_vaar.voor: het een van sy generaals, Ptolemeus, en dié se afstammelinge daar regeer
laat_vaar.na: het Ptolemeus, een van sy generaals, en later dié se afstammelinge daar regeer
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: As written, 'een van sy generaals, Ptolemeus, en dié se afstammelinge' can be misread as a list of three; leading with the name and marking the sequence makes it clear the descendants ruled after him.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original is a normal appositive that reads clearly, while the proposal adds 'later' and puts 'generaals' nearest to 'dié se', so the pronoun's antecedent becomes less clear.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'vaste' says the same as 'vasgestelde' in a simpler, shorter word for Grade 5, which also lowers the long-word count.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The glossary definition is correct as written and 'vasgestelde' carries the sense of a start year that people agreed on, which 'vaste' weakens, so this is not a fault worth sending to the writer.

vlae.teks: Kleopatra (in Engels: Cleopatra) was deel van dié familie.
vlae.rede: 'dié familie' points back to Ptolemeus and his descendants in an earlier block, with the map block in between, so the reference is distant for a learner. Naming Ptolemeus would fix it but adds a three-syllable word against a tight long-word limit, so it is left for a person or the writer to decide.
